about.title: Led by owner Pam McGehee
about.text: Pam and her husband fell in love with Galveston many years ago. After numerous family vacations, girls' trips and weekend getaways with their daughters, Pam decided to invest in their favorite hidden gem and St. Gemma Properties was born. With over 16 years of experience in vacation rental ownership, St. Gemma Properties boasts the expertise and longevity for a successful vacation rental experience.
about.imageAlt: Pam McGehee outside a St. Gemma Properties vacation home

reviews.author: Indra F.
reviews.text: My recent stay at La Onda Azul in Galveston, Texas, was absolutely fantastic. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the host's warm hospitality and the immaculate condition of the property.

reviews.author: Jeff B.
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful time at Twist of Lime! Pamela is without question the most responsive and kindest host. Our party of 16 said how comfortable the house was, not an easy feat for such a large party!

reviews.author: Jody M.
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of staying in several of St. Gemma Properties and each was outstanding. They were close to the beach, shopping and some excellent dining.

facts.heading: Texan owned
facts.text: St. Gemma Properties is 100% owned and operated in Texas, with a local Galveston team.

facts.heading: Check-in and check-out
items: Check-in at 4 p.m. and check-out at 10 a.m.
Self check-in and check-out, with 24-hour check-in
Early arrival or late departure can be arranged at an additional cost, depending on other reservations
Before you leave: bag the trash for the outside bins, run the dishwasher, leave the beds made, set the thermostat and lock the doors

facts.heading: Booking and payment
items: Book direct for 10 to 20 percent less than Airbnb and VRBO
Buy now, pay later is available
The reservation is paid in full before check-in, and the person booking must be the card holder

facts.heading: Travel insurance
facts.text: St. Gemma does not refund cancellations caused by hurricanes, named storms, severe weather, flooding or power outages, so trip insurance is recommended, especially during hurricane season (July 1 to November 1). Rental Guardian travel insurance is offered: ask Pam at 409-203-3285.

facts.heading: House rules
items: No smoking in any property
No parties or events beyond registered guests
Quiet hours 10 p.m. to 7 a.m., under the City of Galveston noise ordinance
No fireworks or candles
Pets only where the listing allows them, with a pet fee; no cats
Occupancy limited to the number of guests on the reservation

facts.heading: Extras for guests
items: Private chefs
Babysitting, reserved ahead by phone
Baby equipment
A 10% off code for golf cart rental at Mark's Kart's of Galveston

facts.heading: Clean and safe stays
items: Enhanced cleaning and disinfection of high-touch surfaces
All towels and bedding washed in hot water of at least 60°C
Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, fire extinguisher and first aid kit
Deadbolt locks and outdoor lighting

facts.heading: During your stay
facts.text: If anything is wrong with the home, call Pam right away at 409-203-3285 and leave a voicemail and a text if there is no answer. After 10 p.m. calls are returned as soon as possible. Problems need to be reported during the stay to be considered.

facts.heading: Management fees
facts.text: The management fee is a percentage of your property's gross rental revenue, quoted by property type, location and services. There are no flat monthly fees, no setup fees and no charge in months with no bookings. Housekeeping is billed separately at cost.

facts.heading: Included in management
items: Listings on Airbnb, VRBO and direct booking, with calendars synced in real time
Dynamic pricing through RevMax at no additional charge
Guest screening and 24/7 guest support
Housekeeping coordination and an inspection after every checkout
Maintenance through vetted local vendors, with your approval before major repairs
Monthly owner statements, reporting through BizCor and a real-time owner portal on Streamline
An annual performance review with revenue projections

facts.heading: Getting started as an owner
items: A free property consultation and revenue projection, by phone or at your property
Pam replies within 48 hours of a rental evaluation request
Most properties are live within 2 to 3 weeks, and most receive a first booking within 72 hours
Block your own dates any time to use the home yourself
Condos are managed too, where the HOA and city rules allow short-term rentals

facts.heading: What Galveston rentals earn
items: Studio or 1 bedroom: $20,000 to $38,000 a year
2 to 3 bedrooms: $42,000 to $72,000 a year
4 to 5 bedrooms: $75,000 to $120,000 a year
6+ bedrooms or luxury: $125,000 to $200,000+ a year
